_comment: Phase 0 perf gate targets for the context-fabric mapped engine on BHSA. Per-call probes are microseconds/call; rss_final_mb is MB. Query times are not listed here as absolute numbers: every query in the recorded TF baseline (baselines/bhsa_tf.json) must run at or below the TF wall time. These targets are NOT enforced yet (current 0.6.0rc1 fails them by design); see Phase 2/3.
